versions.content: If the Service Discovery Module receives a "SubscribeEventgroup" entry, the following step(s) shall be performed in the following order: • Send a SubscribeEventgroupAck / Nack entry using Unicast considering the ap- propriate delay without changing the current counter value and without influencing the current running repetition timer. • Call the BswM with the API BswM_Sd_EventHandlerCurrentState() with state SD_EVENT_HANDLER_REQUESTED only if the state for this EventHandler changed (i.e. has not been SD_EVENT_HANDLER_REQUESTED) • Start the TTL timer according to the value received via the SubscribeEventgroup Entry.
